concerns.text: FR-001 requires acquiring at least one public dataset containing experimental permeability coefficients, yet the accompanying research notes state that no verified open datasets contain such measurements. Without a target variable, the core research question (whether a GNN outperforms a descriptor‑based RF on permeability) cannot be answered, rendering the downstream functional requirements and success criteria untestable.

SC-003 proposes measuring interpretability agreement via Spearman rank‑correlation between the SHAP descriptor ranking (global molecular descriptors) and the GNNExplainer substructure ranking (local graph motifs). These rankings inhabit fundamentally different feature spaces, so the correlation lacks a clear scientific interpretation and may produce misleading conclusions.
